summary_en: The caller asked for pricing for 100 visiting cards. The agent explained that 100 normal-paper cards cost ₹200, matte-finish cards cost ₹350, and the minimum order is 100 cards. The caller clarified that they wanted visiting cards rather than mugs and asked what preference had been recorded; the agent recorded visiting cards and asked them to choose between normal paper and matte finish. The caller said their questions had been answered and ended the call without selecting a finish or placing an order.
